name: journey-identify
comment: Visibility Phase 2, Slice J1-Identify. Proves an uncertain Vault Browse card (Vault Browse Slice 6, landed 2026-08-13) can be identified IN PLACE on the rebuilt Browse face and settles to 'identified' through the SAME card delegate (no grid rebuild -- VaultPage.qml's syncGridModel() ListModel.set() path, not clear+repopulate), paired with one F1 vault-forensics scope=identity response for the same node before and after. Run against tests/lanista_fixtures/journeys/identify-uncertain-v1 (--seed, an absolute path): one comic folder named exactly 'Masterpiece', whose cleaned title has exactly TWO exact matches in the real bundled offline comics catalogue (data/comics_catalog.db: gcd_id 206859 and 218321, independently re-verified by direct query before authoring this fixture -- see fixture.json's own provenance note) -- the SAME real mechanism the Vault Browse execution plan's own Slice 6 scenario (tests/lanista_scenarios/vault_browse_uncertain.json) already proved live, reused here inside J1-Identify's own self-contained fixture. This is the ONLY object name the OLD, retired tests/lanista_scenarios/vault_identify.json targets nothing in common with -- that file is left untouched, per the plan's fence, and is not re-pointed by this slice. The card's exact key/objectName (vaultBrowseCard_C:/users/testuser/desktop/brotherhood/colosseum/tests/lanista_fixtures/journeys/identify-uncertain-v1/media/Masterpiece) and the identify dialog's own ground-truth (VaultIdentifyDialog's Popup wrapper is NOT reachable by objectName through dump-ui/the bridge -- only its CHILDREN vaultIdentifyQuery/vaultIdentifyResults/vaultIdentifyRow_N/vaultIdentifyUse_N are, exactly as Vault Browse Slice 6's own scenario comment already documented) were both confirmed live via dump-ui/qml-get before this scenario was authored (artifacts/visibility-phase2/j1-identify/discovery/). CANDIDATE-COUNT CAVEAT: F1-Core's vault-forensics scope=identity honestly reports candidateCount:-1 (VaultBrowseDetail::detailFor never exposes the real count as a queryable field, only inside its human evidence prose -- F0's own stop law forbids reaching VaultIndex directly to recover it). This scenario therefore never asserts on candidateCount -- only on the STATE TRANSITION (identity.state uncertain -> identified) agreeing between the card's own state property and F1's identity.state, exactly as the plan requires.
